pages.description: Pullman Adelaide is luxury hotel accommodation located close to the city's main shopping precinct, Rundle Mall and within walking distance to Adelaide Oval.Located at the east end of Hindmarsh Square and on the doorstep of the thriving East End of Adelaide. Tranquil park views , Pullman Adelaide is another hidden gem of the CBD of Adelaide. Central ot business and also the best shopping and sporting events that South Australia has to offer.
pages.text:
Pullman Adelaide - Luxury Accommodation Adelaide | Adelaide CBD Hotel
Pullman Adelaide - Luxury hotel
Pullman Adelaide
Welcome to Pullman Adelaide.
CBD Location with the perfect tranquil park setting.
A premium 5-star hotel in the heart of the city. Our 308 rooms and suites offer a fresh, open layout and all-round connectivity. Our rooms are ready to welcome modern-day adventurers and nomads, travelling for business or leisure.
Positioned in the heart of the Adelaide CBD and walking distance to Adelaide Oval and the Adelaide Convention Centre. Located in the education hub of some of city s largest universities. Nestled in the East End of the city and the perfect spot for anyone wanting to be located close to Lot 14.
The Pullman Adelaide is perfect for the corporate traveller. A great spot for the leisure guest when location is the key. If you happen to be in town for an AFL game at Adelaide Oval, take a stroll down Rundle Mall and minutes later you at the game.
The Pullman is now also known for its premium restaurant PARC Brasserie, where we infuse impeccable service with a European menu, featuring the best of the South Australian produce. Parc in its first year has already won an award for best metro restaurant.
Our popular event and conference spaces offer your attendees some of the best natural light conference rooms in the city. While also being located on the 15th floor of the hotel.  Conferences, strategic planning meetings, executive meeting, weddings, award nights, graduations, trade shows and product launches are only some of the many events that we hold at the Pullman Adelaide.
Stay connected with ultra-fast Wi-Fi with unlimited download capabilities throughout the hotel. For those needing to regenerate and re-energize, our second-floor lap-pool with spa & sauna is the place. Need to sweat it out? Level two has your fitness covered with fully equipped Fit Lounge and a Peloton bike zone.
Pullman welcomes all adventurers, globetrotters and explorers – because our world is your playground.

Superior Room
Superior Room
The standard is high at Pullman Adelaide, and our Superior Rooms luxuriously combine everything you need to ensure a relaxing or productive stay. An open-plan room, plush bedding with pillow menu and large light-filled windows make the Pullman Superior Room the perfect place for global nomads to work and play. For guests with reduced mobility, Pullman Adelaide has 11 Accessibility Rooms. Superior Rooms are also available as twin share.
Our Superior, Deluxe and Premium Deluxe rooms are all available with either 1 x king bed or 2 x double beds.
